jobDescription:
About the job

A Reputed E-commerce Company is hiring!

Position:Full Stack Developer


🧾 Job Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled Full Stack Developer to manage, develop, and scale the ecommerce platform. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in React / Next.js frontend and PHP backend systems, along with experience in ecommerce workflows.


🎯 Key Responsibilities

Frontend Development

    Build responsive UI using Next.js and React
    Optimize performance (SSR, SEO, lazy loading)
    Integrate APIs and manage state (Redux / Context API)

Backend Development

    Develop and maintain backend using PHP
    Build RESTful APIs for frontend integration
    Handle authentication, order processing, and business logic

Ecommerce Management

    Maintain product catalog, cart, checkout system
    Integrate payment gateways (eSewa, Khalti, etc.)
    Improve conversion rate and user experience

Database & Performance

    Manage MySql/Mongo DB database
    Optimize queries and server performance
    Ensure data security and backups

DevOps & Deployment

    Deploy apps on hosting/cloud servers/ VPS
    Manage domain, SSL, CDN (Cloudflare)
    Version control using Git


🧠 Required Skills

Must Have:

    Strong experience in:
    Next.js
    React
    PHP
    JavaScript (ES6+)
    REST API development
    MySQL/Mongo DB database management

Good to Have:

    Laravel framework
    Tailwind CSS
    SEO optimization (technical SEO)
    Payment gateway integration experience
    Experience in ecommerce platforms


🧰 Tools & Technologies

    Git / GitHub
    Postman / API testing tools
    cPanel / Cloud hosting
    Google Analytics / Meta Ads tools


🎓 Qualifications

    Bachelor’s degree in IT / Computer Science or related field
    2+ years of experience in full-stack development
    Experience in ecommerce projects preferred


💼 Bonus Skills (Highly Preferred)

    Experience scaling ecommerce platforms
    Knowledge of Headless Commerce
    Familiarity with mobile app APIs
    Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals)


📈 KPIs / Success Metrics

    Website performance (PageSpeed, SEO ranking)
    Conversion rate improvement
    Bug-free deployments
    System uptime & reliability
